nature: MADE_UP_FOR_TESTS: no real person, record or interview. It tests the screen; it is not evidence of anything.
writtenBy: Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-30, from Tom Dyer's fourth account. Architecture: Tom Dyer.
scopeNote: Every item bears on EV23, Mr P's injury. The previous convictions (EV28) and the brick at the cat (EV25) are offered as evidence that Mr M threw this tile: the screen must refuse both for that. His two interviews (EV26, EV27) agree that he threw it and disagree about why, and about whether he took the figure to be a person (E29, E30: for NSW s.35, recklessness as to hurt to a person). No item is offered for an intent to cause grievous bodily harm (NSW s.33): none is in the account.
